referenceFunction.generalComment: Data about the CRT screen production, taken from a US LCA study of CRT and LCD screens. Data represent the production of an average 17inch CRT computer screen in the late 1990s.; UUID: 793b6330-66c2-3c4a-8e31-dbce082d41a9
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This module includes the following production steps: production of the heat sinks (on printed wiring boards), production of housing parts, production of deflection yoke, CRT magnet assembly, CRT shield assembly, audio cable assembly, video cable assembly, connectors, final assembly of the 17 inch computer screen, subsequent packaging and palletising until the complete CRT computer screen is ready to be shipped to the customer.
